key_insight: CompMat-Bench is a 94-task benchmark that evaluates AI agents on real computational materials research steps without rerunning expensive simulations.
engineering_relevance: It gives materials scientists a practical, reproducible way to compare agents on input preparation, output analysis, and workflow execution under controlled guidance.
method: Derived 94 tasks from recent computational materials papers
Precomputed simulation inputs and outputs as fixed ground truth for rule-based scoring
Tested agents under single-task vs workflow settings, with full vs reduced methodological guidance
evidence_signal: Across 94 tasks, agents based on three LLMs achieved 66.0-90.4% pass rates on single tasks with full guidance, while longer workflows and reduced guidance lowered performance.
watch_item: Benchmark results may still depend on how closely task templates and fixed rules match real research workflows, so generalization to open-ended studies should be checked.
paper_title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
